_comment: Drop-in hooks block for the consumer project's
.claude/settings.json. The PostToolUse and Stop hooks are
mandatory; SessionStart is gated on user opt-in during adoption
All commands reference ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} so they work
regardless of where Claude Code was invoked from.

hooks.command: bash -c 'cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.java-coding-standards" 2>/dev/null && git fetch -q origin main 2>/dev/null && [[ $(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main) -gt 0 ]] && echo "NOTE: .java-coding-standards is $(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main) commits behind upstream/main. Run /init-java to refresh." || true'
